# Selected Regions of Interest 

Regions of interest were selected based on differentially methylation results as genes with their surrounding enhancers. 

```{r}
roi_str = "SIM2: chr21:38,058,906-38,123,587 (+)
MEIS1: chr2:66,641,425-66,816,546 (+)
MEIS2: chr15:37,166,996-37,407,814 (-)
NKX6-3: chr8:41,502,810-41,505,817 (-)
WNT5A: chr8:41,502,810-41,505,817 (-)
HOXA2: chr7:27,137,231-27,144,775 (-)
HOXA3: chr7:27,144,834-27,167,002 (-)
CDX2: chr13:28,526,806-28,556,693 (-)
HNF4A: chr20:42,976,152-43,100,947 (+)
GATA6: chr18:19,749,404-19,782,491 (+)
TBX3: chr12:115,104,150-115,132,508 (-)
PAX5: chr9:36,815,317-37,050,082 (-)
TOX3: chr16:52,465,784-52,585,267 (-)
HIVEP2: chr6:143,064,117-143,278,528 (-)
SOX2: chr3:181,427,622-181,435,954 (+)
SOX2-OT: chr3:180,761,334-181,497,511 (-)
"

# IRX2: chr5:2,737,924-2,754,393 (-) 
# IRX5: chr16:54,959,734-54,973,389 (+)
# PDX1: chr13:28,491,143-28,504,608 (+)
# PDX1-AS/PLUTO: chr13:28,388,297-28,504,608 (+)
# GATA4: chr8:11,525,616-11,622,264 (+)
# GATA4_dist_enhancer: chr8:11499600-11,622,264 (+)
# CDX2: chr13:28,526,806-28,556,693 (-)
# TCF7L1: chr2:85,351,212-85,539,335 (+)

tmp = scan(text=roi_str, what=c("character"), quiet=T )
tmp2 = as.data.frame(t(matrix(tmp, nrow=3, ncol=length(tmp)/3)), stringsAsFactors = F)

genes_and_coord = data.frame(gene=gsub(":","", tmp2$V1), strand=gsub("\\(","", gsub("\\)","",tmp2$V3)), stringsAsFactors = F)
genes_and_coord$chrom = as.numeric(gsub("chr","",unlist(sapply(strsplit(tmp2$V2,":"), `[`,1))))
tmp = unlist(sapply(strsplit(tmp2$V2,":"), `[`,2))
tmp2 = strsplit(gsub(",","",tmp), "-")
genes_and_coord$start = as.numeric(unlist(sapply(tmp2, `[`,1)))
genes_and_coord$end = as.numeric(unlist(sapply(tmp2, `[`,2)))

genes_and_coord
```




# Data sets used for validation

  <!-- - *in-vivo* data sets -->
  <!--    - GSE103186 (Huang et al. Cancer Cell 2017). Human IM / non-IM biopsies. 450K -->

     - ESGIv2 IM vs. Non-IM. Illumina Epic

  - Stomach and intestine from WGS atlas

```{r}
## Encode H1esc genomic segments#
Segments = read.delim(gzfile("../../../../Data/ExtData/genome_annotation/Encode/wgEncodeBroadHmmH1hescHMM.bed.gz"), header = F)
Segments = subset(Segments, !grepl("Repetitive\\/CNV", V4))
segment_ranges = GRanges(seqnames = Segments$V1, IRanges(start = Segments$V2, end = Segments$V3, names = Segments$V4))
```


## ESGIv2 / MPIIB

```{r}
esgiv2_env = new.env()
load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/myNorm_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach_anno_sorted.RData", envir = esgiv2_env)

load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/myLoad_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach.RData", envir = esgiv2_env)

```

```{r}
mN_anno_esgiv2 = get("myNorm_anno_sorted", esgiv2_env)
tmp = get("myLoad", esgiv2_env)
ed = as.data.frame(tmp$pd)

healthy_stomach_samples <- subset(ed, Project=="KFR_Healthy_Stomach")$Sample_ID
esgiv2_samples <- subset(ed, Project!="KFR_Healthy_Stomach")$Sample_ID

mN_anno_healthy_stomach <- mN_anno_esgiv2[,colnames(mN_anno_esgiv2)[!colnames(mN_anno_esgiv2) %in% esgiv2_samples ] ]
ed_healthy_stomach <- ed[rownames(ed)[!rownames(ed) %in% esgiv2_samples],]

mN_anno_esgiv2 <- mN_anno_esgiv2[, colnames(mN_anno_esgiv2)[!colnames(mN_anno_esgiv2) %in% healthy_stomach_samples ]]
ed <- ed[rownames(ed)[!rownames(ed) %in% healthy_stomach_samples], ]

ed$Cohort = "This study, ex-vivo clonal"
colnames(ed) = gsub("Sample_ID","SampleID",colnames(ed))
ed = subset(ed, PatientID %in% c("592","594") & Sample_Group %in% c("IM","non-IM"))
ed$Condition = ifelse(ed$Sample_Group=="IM","IM","Normal")

anno_epic = mN_anno_esgiv2[, c("CHR","MAPINFO","Strand","Type","gene","feature","cgi","feat.cgi","UCSC_Islands_Name")]
colnames(anno_epic) = gsub("UCSC_Islands_Name","UCSC_CpG_Islands_Name", colnames(anno_epic))

# Add genomic segmentation labels  
myNorm_ranges = with(anno_epic, GRanges(seqnames = paste0("chr", as.character(CHR)), IRanges(start = MAPINFO, end = MAPINFO, names = rownames(mN_anno_esgiv2)) ) )

seg_ovlp = findOverlaps(segment_ranges, myNorm_ranges)
anno_epic$Seg = NA
anno_epic$Seg[subjectHits(seg_ovlp)] = names(segment_ranges[queryHits(seg_ovlp)])

```


# Differentially methylated  CpGs between IM and normal stomach in ESGIv2

FDR < 10% and |logFC| > 0.2

```{r}

load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated.RData")

tmp = all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormal"]]
tmp$comparison = "IMvsNormal"
tmp = subset(tmp, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) >= 0.2)

all_dm_df = merge(tmp, anno_epic, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
setorder(all_dm_df, CHR,MAPINFO)
unique_dm_ids = unique(all_dm_df$Row.names)

```


```{r}

rm(esgiv2_env, mN_anno_esgiv2, myNorm_ranges)
dummy = gc(verbose=F)

```

# Heatmaps for selected TF

```{r}
anno_colors = list("CGI"=c("island"="red","opensea"="grey","shelf"="brown","shore"="yellow"),
                   "Condition"=c("IM"="orange","Normal"="lightblue", "Healthy Antrum"="green","Healthy Corpus"="blue","Healthy Fundus"="magenta",
                                 "Small intestine"="orange", "Right Colon"="red1","Left Colon"="red4" ),
                   "Feature"=c("IGR"="grey80","TSS1500"="red","TSS200"="orange","5'UTR"="pink","1stExon"="brown4","ExonBnd"="rosybrown","Body"="green","3'UTR"="blue"),
                   "DM"=c("DM"="black","n.s."="white"),
                   "Cohort"=c("Fritsche et al. ex-vivo PC"="green","This study, ex-vivo clonal"="blue","This study, ex-vivo polyclonal"="purple", "Healthy_stomach"="brown", "WGBS"="orange"))

breaksList = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)
new_colors = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdYlBu")))(length(breaksList))

cond_ordered = c("Normal","IM","Healthy Fundus","Healthy Corpus","Healthy Antrum", "Small intestine","Right Colon", "Left Colon")
cohorts_ordered = c("This study, ex-vivo clonal","This study, ex-vivo polyclonal","Fritsche et al. ex-vivo PC","Healthy_stomach","WGBS")
```

## TFs

```{r}
# we assume that the annotation tables are already sorted by chromosome and CpG position
extract_subtables <- function(ds, chr, start, end) {
  cpg_ids = sapply(ds, function(x) {rownames(subset(x[["anno"]], as.character(CHR)==as.character(chr) & MAPINFO >= start & MAPINFO <= end))})

  id_cnts = table(unlist(cpg_ids))
  shared_ids = names(id_cnts)[id_cnts==length(cpg_ids)]
  
  row_anno = ds[[1]][["anno"]][shared_ids,]
  row_anno = row_anno[order(row_anno$CHR, row_anno$MAPINFO),]
  shared_ids = rownames(row_anno)
    
  #matrices = mapply(function(x, ids) {x[["mat"]][ids,]}, ds, cpg_ids)
  matrices =  lapply(ds, function(x) x[["mat"]][shared_ids,] )
  
  combined_matrices = do.call(cbind, matrices)
  
  combined_ed = do.call(rbind, lapply(ds, function(x) x[["ed"]]))
  combined_ed$Condition = factor(combined_ed$Condition, levels=cond_ordered)
  combined_ed$Cohort = factor(combined_ed$Cohort, levels=cohorts_ordered)
  combined_ed = combined_ed[order(combined_ed$Cohort, combined_ed$Condition, combined_ed$SampleID),]
  
  combined_matrices = combined_matrices[, combined_ed$SampleID]
  
  
  return(list(combined_matrices, combined_ed, row_anno))
} 
  
```

```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=10}
for (ri in 1:nrow(genes_and_coord)) {
  r_chr = genes_and_coord[ri,"chrom"]
  r_start = genes_and_coord[ri,"start"]
  r_end = genes_and_coord[ri,"end"]
  
  rr = extract_subtables(all_ds, r_chr, r_start, r_end)
  mat = rr[[1]]
  ed = rr[[2]]
  anno = rr[[3]]

  rownames(mat) = anno$MAPINFO
  
  row_anno <- data.frame("Feature" = anno$feature,
                         "cgi" = anno$cgi,
                         "Segment" = as.factor(anno$Seg),
                         "DM" = anno$DM,
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rownames(row_anno) <- anno$MAPINFO
  colnames(row_anno) <- c("Feature", "CGI", "Segment","DM")
  
  col_anno = ed[, c("Condition","Cohort")]
  
  pheatmap(mat, cluster_row=F, cluster_col=F, main = paste0(genes_and_coord[ri,"gene"], " (chr", r_chr,":",r_start,"-",r_end,")"), annotation_col = col_anno, annotation_row = row_anno, breaks = breaksList, cluster_cols = F, annotation_colors = anno_colors, gaps_col = cumsum(table(ed$Cohort))[1:(length(unique(ed$Cohort))-1)])
}
```
